ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diameter $AB$ of $\odot O$ is perpendicular to the chord $CD$, with the foot of the perpendicular being $E$. If $\angle B = 60^\circ$ and $AC = 6$, what is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw $AD$,\\
since the diameter $AB$ of the circle $O$ is perpendicular to the chord $CD$ at the foot $E$,\\
it follows that $AE=AE$, $CE=DE$, $\angle AED=\angle AEC=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\triangle AED\cong \triangle AEC$ (by SAS),\\
hence $AD=AC$,\\
since $\angle B=60^\circ$, $AC=6$,\\
it follows that $\angle BCE=30^\circ$,\\
since $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ACE=\angle ACB-\angle BCE=60^\circ$,\\
similarly, it can be found that: $\angle ADE=60^\circ$,\\
hence $\triangle ACD$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
therefore $CD=AC=\boxed{6}$.

method.method_draft: From the image, set up coordinates with the diameter AB as the x-axis and center O as the origin; A is the left endpoint and B the right endpoint of the circle, while chord CD is perpendicular to AB and therefore vertical. From the text, ∠B=60° and AC=6. Since AB is a diameter, ∠ACB=90°, so triangle ABC is a 30-60-90 triangle with AC opposite 60°; hence the diameter AB=4√3 and the radius is R=2√3. Put A=(-2√3,0), B=(2√3,0), and let C=(x,y) on the circle x^2+y^2=12. The condition AC=6 gives (x+2√3)^2+y^2=36. Subtracting x^2+y^2=12 yields 4√3x+12=24, so x=√3. Then y^2=12-3=9, so C has vertical distance 3 from AB. Since CD is the vertical chord through x=√3, its endpoints have y=±3, so CD=6.

推理：按照指定方法，把坐标系旋转，使直径 AB 作为 x 轴，圆心 O 为原点。设 A 为左端点，B 为右端点，则 A=(-R,0), B=(R,0)。因为 AB 是直径，所以 ∠ACB=90°。已知 ∠B=60°，AC=6，因此三角形 ABC 是 30°-60°-90°三角形，其中 AC 对应 60°。于是 AB=4√3，半径 R=2√3。故取 A=(-2√3,0), B=(2√3,0)，圆方程为 x^2+y^2=12。设 C=(x,y)。由 AC=6，有 (x+2√3)^2+y^2=36。再由 C 在圆上，有 x^2+y^2=12。两式相减得 4√3x+12=24，所以 x=√3。代入圆方程得 y^2=12-3=9，所以 C 到直径 AB 的垂直距离为 3。由于 CD 是过 C 且垂直于 AB 的弦，在该坐标系中是直线 x=√3，与圆交于 y=3 和 y=-3 两点，因此 CD=3-(-3)=6。

since $\angle B=60^\circ$, $AC=6$,\\

it follows that $\angle ACE=\angle ACB-\angle BCE=60^\circ$,\\
similarly, it can be found that: $\angle ADE=60^\circ$,\\
hence $\triangle ACD$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
therefore $CD=AC=\boxed{6}$
